# Generative Models for Discrete Data

The first six fields are the chapter's own. The block between the markers is the source-note
record every chapter of this book shares, authored once in
`content/research/books/msmb/book.yml` and copied here by `npm run books`. `citation` is a
template there — `{n}` and `{title}` are filled from the chapter's own frontmatter — which is
why the copies differ chapter to chapter while the source stays one line.

It is COPIED rather than merged in while validating, so a chapter note validates from its own
frontmatter like every other note in the corpus: no file reads inside a zod schema, and the
kind manifest lists what a book chapter actually carries. `npm run check:books` fails CI if a
copy drifts from `book.yml`, which is what keeps the copy from becoming a second source of
truth — the same trade `kinds.generated.json` makes.

This book is NC-SA, so the posture is `own-words-summary` and no `attribution` is owed: the
summary reproduces no upstream expression to give notice for. `harmon-pcm` is CC-BY-4.0 and
does quote, so its `book.yml` carries the notice and its chapters validate under the same rule.
